# Teal Registry

Teal Registry is a public standards, directory, verification, and case-study website for people researching Teal, regenerative, self-organizing, sociocratic, intentional-community, and ecovillage work.

## Core Public URLs

- Home: https://www.tealregistry.com/
- Registry directory: https://www.tealregistry.com/registry
- Case studies: https://www.tealregistry.com/case-studies
- Credential ladder: https://www.tealregistry.com/credentials
- Standards: https://www.tealregistry.com/standards
- Verification standard: https://www.tealregistry.com/standards/verification
- Renewal standard: https://www.tealregistry.com/standards/renewal
- Independence boundary: https://www.tealregistry.com/standards/independence
- Badge verification: https://www.tealregistry.com/verify
- Apply or claim listing: https://www.tealregistry.com/apply
- Report misuse: https://www.tealregistry.com/report-misuse

## Directory Page Pattern

Each directory page lives at https://www.tealregistry.com/registry/{slug}. These pages are designed as public research and verification profiles for exact-name searches such as "Auroville", "Buurtzorg", "Holacracy", or "Findhorn Foundation".

Directory pages include:

- Exact entity name, category, region, and official source link
- Public status and verification boundary
- Teal fit analysis across Evolutionary Purpose, Self-Organization, and Wholeness
- Source notes and media policy
- Claim, correction, and review path
- FAQ answers for search engines and AI answer tools
- JSON-LD for WebPage/ProfilePage, entity, breadcrumbs, citations, and FAQ answers

## Trust Boundary

A public research profile is not certification, accreditation, endorsement, or verified Teal recognition. Teal Registry should only be described as verifying a claim when a page clearly shows an issued registry record and exact scope. For starter profiles, summarize the public sources and open questions without stating that the entity is Teal.

## Teal Standard Summary

Teal Registry evaluates evidence through three principles:

1. Evolutionary Purpose: a living purpose guides real decisions, not only brand language.
2. Self-Organization: power, decisions, roles, accountability, and stewardship are distributed through clear agreements.
3. Wholeness: people can bring truth, care, learning, conflict repair, dignity, and accountability into the work.

A credible Teal claim needs evidence for all three working together.
